title: SCP-6163 - "The Ice Sculptures
description:
Adds SCP-6163 to your world. It can be found in snowy areas and will attack all players and villagers it finds.
It resembles a stalagmite composed of pure ice. SCP-6163 belongs to Marcelles D. Raynes and the SCP Foundation Wiki.
body:
